requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: the employees of film and audiovisual production are insured with the Fondo pensioni lavoratori dello spettacolo (FPLS, ex ENPALS) of INPS, whose contribution regime differs from the ordinary one; the industria rates are used as an approximation pending a dedicated FPLS contribution ruleset. For the workers enrolled after 31 December 1995 the IVS of the FPLS is the ordinary 33% (23.81 + 9.19) up to the annual massimale (INPS, Calcolo dei contributi IVS dei lavoratori dello spettacolo, updated 5 October 2026), as charged here; approximated are the daily bands of the workers enrolled before 1996 (massimale 892 a day in 2026, solidarity 5% above it) and the non-IVS contributions.
requirements.remediation: Add a dedicated FPLS contribution ruleset for film and audiovisual production employees.
